local_context.value: Goose Creek: 11.9% of residents were 65 or older (2020 census); elevation 13 ft in southern Berkeley County, bordered on the east by the Cooper River and Back River; about 42.8 sq mi; St. James Church and Otranto Plantation Indigo Vats are on the National Register.

neighborhoods.value: Crowfield Plantation (golf community; the city site links Crowfield Golf and The Crowfield Collaborative). No official neighborhood list found; others (Liberty Hall Plantation, Boulder Bluff, Carnes Crossroads) appear only in realtor sources.

place_entities.value: Central Creek Park; Joseph S. Daning Amphitheater; Marguerite H. Brown Municipal Center (City Hall, 519 N. Goose Creek Blvd); St. James-Goose Creek Church (NRHP); Naval Weapons Station (Joint Base Charleston).
